first.rationale: Verify the two most decision-relevant alternatives: promotional pricing directly addresses competitive pressure but its claimed lift does not establish durable retention or qualified revenue, while onboarding simplification addresses the current completion and activation declines and has evidence of improved adoption. Pending verification, simplify onboarding is the stronger sustainability-aligned choice; pricing carries downstream margin and customer-quality risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite competitive pressure: its verified qualified-revenue lift was accompanied by 30-day retention declining 12%, indicating material downstream value risk.
